164class ScalingList
165{
166public:
167 ScalingList();
168 virtual ~ScalingList() { }
169
170 int* getScalingListAddress(uint32_t scalingListId) { return &(m_scalingListCoef[scalingListId][0]); }
171 const int* getScalingListAddress(uint32_t scalingListId) const { return &(m_scalingListCoef[scalingListId][0]); }
172 void checkPredMode(uint32_t scalingListId);
173
174 void setRefMatrixId(uint32_t scalingListId, uint32_t u) { m_refMatrixId[scalingListId] = u; }
175 uint32_t getRefMatrixId(uint32_t scalingListId) const { return m_refMatrixId[scalingListId]; }
176
177 static const int* getScalingListDefaultAddress(uint32_t scalinListId);
178 void processDefaultMatrix(uint32_t scalinListId);
179
180 void setScalingListDC(uint32_t scalinListId, uint32_t u) { m_scalingListDC[scalinListId] = u; }
181 int getScalingListDC(uint32_t scalinListId) const { return m_scalingListDC[scalinListId]; }
182
183 void setScalingListCopyModeFlag(uint32_t scalinListId, bool bIsCopy) { m_scalingListPredModeFlagIsCopy[scalinListId] = bIsCopy; }
184 bool getScalingListCopyModeFlag(uint32_t scalinListId) const { return m_scalingListPredModeFlagIsCopy[scalinListId]; } //getScalingListPredModeFlag
185 void processRefMatrix(uint32_t scalingListId, uint32_t refListId);
186
187 int lengthUvlc(int uiCode);
188 int lengthSvlc(int uiCode);
189 void CheckBestPredScalingList(int scalingListId, int predListIdx, int& BitsCount);
190 void codePredScalingList(int* scalingList, const int* scalingListPred, int scalingListDC, int scalingListPredDC, int scalinListId, int& bitsCost);
191 void codeScalingList(int* scalingList, int scalingListDC, int scalinListId, int& bitsCost);
192 void setScalingListPreditorModeFlag(uint32_t scalingListId, bool bIsPred) { m_scalingListPreditorModeFlag[scalingListId] = bIsPred; }
193 bool getScalingListPreditorModeFlag(uint32_t scalingListId) const { return m_scalingListPreditorModeFlag[scalingListId]; }
194 bool getChromaScalingListPresentFlag() const {return m_chromaScalingListPresentFlag;}
195 void setChromaScalingListPresentFlag( bool flag) { m_chromaScalingListPresentFlag = flag;}
196 bool isLumaScalingList( int scalingListId) const;
197 void checkDcOfMatrix();
198 bool xParseScalingList(const std::string &fileName);
199 void setDefaultScalingList();
200 bool isNotDefaultScalingList();
201
202 bool operator==( const ScalingList& other )
203 {
204 if (memcmp(m_scalingListPredModeFlagIsCopy, other.m_scalingListPredModeFlagIsCopy, sizeof(m_scalingListPredModeFlagIsCopy)))
205 {
206 return false;
207 }
208 if( memcmp( m_scalingListDC, other.m_scalingListDC, sizeof( m_scalingListDC ) ) )
209 {
210 return false;
211 }
212 if( memcmp( m_refMatrixId, other.m_refMatrixId, sizeof( m_refMatrixId ) ) )
213 {
214 return false;
215 }
216 if( memcmp( m_scalingListCoef, other.m_scalingListCoef, sizeof( m_scalingListCoef ) ) )
217 {
218 return false;
219 }
220
221 return true;
222 }
223
224 bool operator!=( const ScalingList& other )
225 {
226 return !( *this == other );
227 }
228
229private:
230 void outputScalingLists(std::ostream &os) const;
231 bool m_scalingListPredModeFlagIsCopy [30];
232 int m_scalingListDC [30];
233 uint32_t m_refMatrixId [30];
234 bool m_scalingListPreditorModeFlag [30];
235 std::vector<int> m_scalingListCoef [30];
236 bool m_chromaScalingListPresentFlag;
237};

591class SliceReshapeInfo
592{
593public:
594 bool sliceReshaperEnableFlag;
595 bool sliceReshaperModelPresentFlag;
596 unsigned enableChromaAdj;
597 uint32_t reshaperModelMinBinIdx;
598 uint32_t reshaperModelMaxBinIdx;
599 int reshaperModelBinCWDelta[PIC_CODE_CW_BINS];
600 int maxNbitsNeededDeltaCW;
601 int chrResScalingOffset;
602 void setUseSliceReshaper(bool b) { sliceReshaperEnableFlag = b; }
603 bool getUseSliceReshaper() const { return sliceReshaperEnableFlag; }
604 void setSliceReshapeModelPresentFlag(bool b) { sliceReshaperModelPresentFlag = b; }
605 bool getSliceReshapeModelPresentFlag() const { return sliceReshaperModelPresentFlag; }
606 void setSliceReshapeChromaAdj(unsigned adj) { enableChromaAdj = adj; }
607 unsigned getSliceReshapeChromaAdj() const { return enableChromaAdj; }
608
609 bool operator==( const SliceReshapeInfo& other )
610 {
611 if( sliceReshaperEnableFlag != other.sliceReshaperEnableFlag )
612 {
613 return false;
614 }
615 if( sliceReshaperModelPresentFlag != other.sliceReshaperModelPresentFlag )
616 {
617 return false;
618 }
619 if( enableChromaAdj != other.enableChromaAdj )
620 {
621 return false;
622 }
623 if( reshaperModelMinBinIdx != other.reshaperModelMinBinIdx )
624 {
625 return false;
626 }
627 if( reshaperModelMaxBinIdx != other.reshaperModelMaxBinIdx )
628 {
629 return false;
630 }
631 if( maxNbitsNeededDeltaCW != other.maxNbitsNeededDeltaCW )
632 {
633 return false;
634 }
635 if (chrResScalingOffset != other.chrResScalingOffset)
636 {
637 return false;
638 }
639 if( memcmp( reshaperModelBinCWDelta, other.reshaperModelBinCWDelta, sizeof( reshaperModelBinCWDelta ) ) )
640 {
641 return false;
642 }
643
644 return true;
645 }
646
647 bool operator!=( const SliceReshapeInfo& other )
648 {
649 return !( *this == other );
650 }
651};

723class SliceMap
724{
725private:
726 uint32_t m_sliceID;
727 uint32_t m_numTilesInSlice;
728 uint32_t m_numCtuInSlice;
729 std::vector<uint32_t> m_ctuAddrInSlice;
730
731public:
732 SliceMap();
733 virtual ~SliceMap();
734
735 void setSliceID( uint32_t u ) { m_sliceID = u; }
736 uint32_t getSliceID() const { return m_sliceID; }
737 void setNumTilesInSlice( uint32_t u ) { m_numTilesInSlice = u; }
738 uint32_t getNumTilesInSlice() const { return m_numTilesInSlice; }
739 void setNumCtuInSlice( uint32_t u ) { m_numCtuInSlice = u; }
740 uint32_t getNumCtuInSlice() const { return m_numCtuInSlice; }
741 std::vector<uint32_t> getCtuAddrList( ) const { return m_ctuAddrInSlice; }
742 uint32_t getCtuAddrInSlice( int idx ) const { CHECK(idx >= m_ctuAddrInSlice.size(), "CTU index exceeds number of CTUs in slice."); return m_ctuAddrInSlice[idx]; }
743 void pushToCtuAddrInSlice( uint32_t u ) { m_ctuAddrInSlice.push_back(u); m_numCtuInSlice++;}
744
745 void initSliceMap()
746 {
747 m_sliceID = 0;
748 m_numTilesInSlice = 0;
749 m_numCtuInSlice = 0;
750 m_ctuAddrInSlice.clear();
751 }
752
753 void addCtusToSlice( uint32_t startX, uint32_t stopX, uint32_t startY, uint32_t stopY, uint32_t picWidthInCtbsY )
754 {
755 CHECK( startX >= stopX || startY >= stopY, "Invalid slice definition");
756 for( uint32_t ctbY = startY; ctbY < stopY; ctbY++ )
757 {
758 for( uint32_t ctbX = startX; ctbX < stopX; ctbX++ )
759 {
760 m_ctuAddrInSlice.push_back( ctbY * picWidthInCtbsY + ctbX );
761 m_numCtuInSlice++;
762 }
763 }
764 }
765};

836 uint32_t getFirstCTUInSubPic () const { return m_firstCtuInSubPic; }

851 uint32_t getSubPicHeightInLumaSample() const { return m_subPicHeightInLumaSample; }
852
853 std::vector<uint32_t> getCtuAddrList () const { return m_ctuAddrInSubPic; }
854 void clearCTUAddrList() { m_ctuAddrInSubPic.clear(); }
855 void addCTUsToSubPic(std::vector<uint32_t> ctuAddrInSlice)
856 {
857 for (auto ctu:ctuAddrInSlice)
858 m_ctuAddrInSubPic.push_back(ctu);
859 }
860 void addAllCtusInPicToSubPic(uint32_t startX, uint32_t stopX, uint32_t startY, uint32_t stopY, uint32_t picWidthInCtbsY)
861 {
862 CHECK(startX >= stopX || startY >= stopY, "Invalid slice definition");
863 for (uint32_t ctbY = startY; ctbY < stopY; ctbY++)
864 {
865 for (uint32_t ctbX = startX; ctbX < stopX; ctbX++)
866 {
867 m_ctuAddrInSubPic.push_back(ctbY * picWidthInCtbsY + ctbX);
868 }
869 }
870 }
871 bool isContainingPos(const Position& pos) const
872 {
873 return pos.x >= m_subPicLeft && pos.x <= m_subPicRight && pos.y >= m_subPicTop && pos.y <= m_subPicBottom;
874 }
875 void setTreatedAsPicFlag (bool u) { m_treatedAsPicFlag = u; }
876 bool getTreatedAsPicFlag () const { return m_treatedAsPicFlag; }
877 void setloopFilterAcrossEnabledFlag(bool u) { m_loopFilterAcrossSubPicEnabledFlag = u; }
878 bool getloopFilterAcrossEnabledFlag() const { return m_loopFilterAcrossSubPicEnabledFlag; }
879
880 bool isFirstCTUinSubPic(uint32_t ctuAddr) const { return ctuAddr == m_firstCtuInSubPic; }
881 bool isLastCTUinSubPic(uint32_t ctuAddr) const { return ctuAddr == m_lastCtuInSubPic; }
882 void setNumSlicesInSubPic( uint32_t val ) { m_numSlicesInSubPic = val; }
883 uint32_t getNumSlicesInSubPic() const { return m_numSlicesInSubPic; }
884 bool containsCtu(const Position& pos) const
885 {
886 return pos.x >= m_subPicCtuTopLeftX && pos.x < m_subPicCtuTopLeftX + m_subPicWidth &&
887 pos.y >= m_subPicCtuTopLeftY && pos.y < m_subPicCtuTopLeftY + m_subPicHeight;
888 }
889 bool containsCtu(int ctuAddr) const
890 {
891 for (auto & addr : m_ctuAddrInSubPic)
892 {
893 if (addr == ctuAddr)
894 {
895 return true;
896 }
897 }
898 return false;
899 }
900};

1169 , m_winBottomOffset(0)
1170 { }

1175 int getWindowRightOffset() const { return m_enabledFlag ? m_winRightOffset : 0; }
1176 void setWindowRightOffset(int val) { m_winRightOffset = val; m_enabledFlag |= (val!=0); }
1177 int getWindowTopOffset() const { return m_enabledFlag ? m_winTopOffset : 0; }
1178 void setWindowTopOffset(int val) { m_winTopOffset = val; m_enabledFlag |= (val!=0); }
1179 int getWindowBottomOffset() const { return m_enabledFlag ? m_winBottomOffset: 0; }
1180 void setWindowBottomOffset(int val) { m_winBottomOffset = val; m_enabledFlag |= (val!=0); }
1181
1182 void setWindow(int offsetLeft, int offsetRight, int offsetTop, int offsetBottom)
1183 {
1184 m_enabledFlag = (offsetLeft || offsetRight || offsetTop || offsetBottom);
1185 m_winLeftOffset = offsetLeft;
1186 m_winRightOffset = offsetRight;
1187 m_winTopOffset = offsetTop;
1188 m_winBottomOffset = offsetBottom;
1189 }

2076 return m_ChromaQpAdjTableIncludingNullEntry[cuChromaQpOffsetIdxPlus1]; // Array includes entry [0] for the null offset used when cu_chroma_qp_offset_flag=0, and entries [cu_chroma_qp_offset_idx+1...] otherwise
2077 }

2079 void setChromaQpOffsetListEntry( int cuChromaQpOffsetIdxPlus1, int cbOffset, int crOffset, int jointCbCrOffset )
2080 {
2081 CHECK(cuChromaQpOffsetIdxPlus1 == 0 || cuChromaQpOffsetIdxPlus1 > MAX_QP_OFFSET_LIST_SIZE, "Invalid chroma QP offset");
2082 m_ChromaQpAdjTableIncludingNullEntry[cuChromaQpOffsetIdxPlus1].u.comp.CbOffset = cbOffset; // Array includes entry [0] for the null offset used when cu_chroma_qp_offset_flag=0, and entries [cu_chroma_qp_offset_idx+1...] otherwise
2083 m_ChromaQpAdjTableIncludingNullEntry[cuChromaQpOffsetIdxPlus1].u.comp.CrOffset = crOffset;
2084 m_ChromaQpAdjTableIncludingNullEntry[cuChromaQpOffsetIdxPlus1].u.comp.JointCbCrOffset = jointCbCrOffset;
2085 m_chromaQpOffsetListLen = std::max(m_chromaQpOffsetListLen, cuChromaQpOffsetIdxPlus1);
2086 }

2301struct WPScalingParam
2302{
2303 // Explicit weighted prediction parameters parsed in slice header,
2304 // or Implicit weighted prediction parameters (8 bits depth values).
2305 bool presentFlag;
2306 uint32_t log2WeightDenom;
2307 int codedWeight;
2308 int codedOffset;
2309
2310 // Weighted prediction scaling values built from above parameters (bitdepth scaled):
2311 int w;
2312 int o;
2313 int offset;
2314 int shift;
2315 int round;
2316
2317 static bool isWeighted(const WPScalingParam *wp);
2318};
2319
2320inline bool WPScalingParam::isWeighted(const WPScalingParam *wp)
2321{
2322 return wp != nullptr && (wp[COMPONENT_Y].presentFlag || wp[COMPONENT_Cb].presentFlag || wp[COMPONENT_Cr].presentFlag);
2323}

3034class PreCalcValues
3035{
3036public:
3037 PreCalcValues( const SPS& sps, const PPS& pps, bool _isEncoder )
3038 : chrFormat ( sps.getChromaFormatIdc() )
3039 , multiBlock422 ( false )
3040 , maxCUWidth ( sps.getMaxCUWidth() )
3041 , maxCUHeight ( sps.getMaxCUHeight() )
3042 , maxCUWidthMask ( maxCUWidth - 1 )
3043 , maxCUHeightMask ( maxCUHeight - 1 )
3044 , maxCUWidthLog2 ( floorLog2( maxCUWidth ) )
3045 , maxCUHeightLog2 ( floorLog2( maxCUHeight ) )
3046 , minCUWidth ( 1 << MIN_CU_LOG2 )
3047 , minCUHeight ( 1 << MIN_CU_LOG2 )
3048 , minCUWidthLog2 ( floorLog2( minCUWidth ) )
3049 , minCUHeightLog2 ( floorLog2( minCUHeight ) )
3050 , partsInCtuWidth ( maxCUWidth >> MIN_CU_LOG2)
3051 , partsInCtuHeight ( maxCUHeight >> MIN_CU_LOG2)
3052 , partsInCtu ( partsInCtuWidth * partsInCtuHeight )
3053 , widthInCtus ( (pps.getPicWidthInLumaSamples () + sps.getMaxCUWidth () - 1) / sps.getMaxCUWidth () )
3054 , heightInCtus ( (pps.getPicHeightInLumaSamples() + sps.getMaxCUHeight() - 1) / sps.getMaxCUHeight() )
3055 , sizeInCtus ( widthInCtus * heightInCtus )
3056 , lumaWidth ( pps.getPicWidthInLumaSamples() )
3057 , lumaHeight ( pps.getPicHeightInLumaSamples() )
3058 , fastDeltaQPCuMaxSize( Clip3(1u << sps.getLog2MinCodingBlockSize(), sps.getMaxCUHeight(), 32u) )
3059 , noChroma2x2 ( false )
3060 , isEncoder ( _isEncoder )
3061 , ISingleTree ( !sps.getUseDualITree() )
3062 , maxBtDepth { sps.getMaxMTTHierarchyDepthI(), sps.getMaxMTTHierarchyDepth(), sps.getMaxMTTHierarchyDepthIChroma() }
3063 , minBtSize { 1u << sps.getLog2MinCodingBlockSize(), 1u << sps.getLog2MinCodingBlockSize(), 1u << sps.getLog2MinCodingBlockSize() }
3064 , maxBtSize { sps.getMaxBTSizeI(), sps.getMaxBTSize(), sps.getMaxBTSizeIChroma() }
3065 , minTtSize { 1u << sps.getLog2MinCodingBlockSize(), 1u << sps.getLog2MinCodingBlockSize(), 1u << sps.getLog2MinCodingBlockSize() }
3066 , maxTtSize { sps.getMaxTTSizeI(), sps.getMaxTTSize(), sps.getMaxTTSizeIChroma() }
3067 , minQtSize { sps.getMinQTSize(I_SLICE, CHANNEL_TYPE_LUMA), sps.getMinQTSize(B_SLICE, CHANNEL_TYPE_LUMA), sps.getMinQTSize(I_SLICE, CHANNEL_TYPE_CHROMA) }
3068 {}
